SRC-031:R001.text: CORE-001: a failed pack must never remove or overwrite the previous good archive when backup establishment or later verification fails

SRC-031:R002.text: CORE-002: every non-project config mutation rebases on the latest durable state and fails closed instead of writing a stale registry

SRC-031:R003.text: CORE-003: the Windows/Ubuntu CI retry contract is green and diagnostic redaction is host-independent

SRC-031:R004.text: CORE-004: one consistent release version, enforced by regression

SRC-031:R005.text: W2-001: final-wave completion is published only after one verified durable campaign commit, and incomplete rollback is explicit and recoverable

SRC-031:R006.text: W2-002: the INAUDIT body+metadata lifecycle survives split moves and corrupt bytes without losing API access

SRC-031:R007.text: W2-003: project completion matches canonical ids without cross-namespace name/id collisions

SRC-031:R008.text: W2-004: dispatch transitions cannot diverge between memory, jobs.json and generation under partial persistence, and terminal retries are idempotent

SRC-031:R009.text: W2-005: single-instance ownership never fails open merely because a live owner's window is not yet visible

SRC-031:R010.text: PERF-001: INAUDIT retry processing is O(N) in local queue work with bounded transport probing during a global outage, durability semantics unchanged

SRC-031:R011.text: PERF-002: periodic audit-run refresh scales with live/changed runs rather than retained history, batches intent reconciliation and performs one Bridge-status fetch
